title: Concurrency, Parallelism, and Thread Safety Check

questions.prompt: What should atomically update MutableStateFlow state?
questions.explanation: Atomic compare-and-set retries prevent lost read-modify-write changes.

questions.prompt: Coroutine code cannot race if it begins on one thread.
questions.explanation: Suspension, re-entry, and dispatcher changes can interleave operations.

questions.prompt: Where should slow I/O run relative to a Mutex?
questions.explanation: Only the small invariant-changing commit should hold the critical section.
